about_the_game:
In this spin-off of Intrepid Izzy, the plucky heroine returns to explore a video game arcade filled with strange, funny, quirky and experimental little games. The arcade games found in the original will be back in an updated form, and of course there will be all-new ones to discover as well.

Retro Arcade Minigames

Discover a range of (experimental) games, inspired by the 8-bit and 16-bit classics. Each of the arcade minigames has its own distinct mechanics, but is easy to pick up and play without requiring any instructions.

Colourful Overworld

Arcade games belong in an arcade, and so that's where we've placed them. And the arcade doesn't exist in a vacuum either. It's all wrapped in a neat little world for you to explore.

Fully Configurable Controls

The controls for each game can be configured individually, and Izzy's Arcade has built-in support for all USB game controllers (not just Xbox and PlayStation ones).

Online highscores

Measure yourself against the world! A built-in scoreboard shows the top players for each of the arcade games, as well as your place in the global rankings.
